description:
Create a book digitization order from a public HTTPS file_url (up to 100 MiB) or a completed multipart upload key (up to 500 MiB).

Requires rights_confirmed=true (confirming copyright / permission to digitize). Nothing is charged yet: the book
starts in status splitting while the worker renders pages; poll get_book until status is ready (page_count is now
known), then call estimate_book and start_book (mode='sample' for a free 10-page probe or mode='full' for paid
full digitization). orthography is auto (default), preserve (pre-1918 Russian: ѣ, і, ѳ) or modern. Reuse
idempotency_key when retrying after a network timeout so the file is not uploaded twice.

file_url.description: Public HTTPS link to a PDF or ZIP archive of page images (up to 100 MiB).
file_url.title: File Url

key.description: Completed upload key from POST /books/uploads/complete (for scans up to 500 MiB). Mutually exclusive with file_url.
key.title: Key

mime.description: Optional MIME type (detected automatically from file_url or key extension when omitted).
mime.title: Mime

name.description: File name when not obvious from key or file_url.
name.title: Name

orthography.description: auto = detect from book text/sample; preserve = pre-1918 Russian orthography (ѣ, і, ѳ, ъ); modern = modern Russian.
orthography.title: Orthography

rights_confirmed.description: Must be true: confirms the caller holds copyright / permission to digitize this book.
rights_confirmed.title: Rights Confirmed

name: create_book
